blocks.title: Signed provenance chain — Decentralized Identity & Verifiable Credentials
blocks.note: The chain anchors evidence, not data dumps — audit exports re-verify against the anchor and fail loudly if history has been edited.

blocks.x: Every component in Decentralized Identity & Verifiable Credentials has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Decentralized Identity & Verifiable Credentials capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: The ledger used where tamper-evidence earns its cost — everything else stays a database with a backup.
Personal data never written on-ledger — hashes and references only, verified in design review.
Keys rotated on ceremony with HSM custody — the compromise of one secret is never the compromise of the estate.
